# Google Play release notes for the next build (at most 500 characters).
# Lines starting with # are ignored.

• Confirm it's you is on for everyone. "Not now" puts off only that one request.
• Rooms show the posts from your last visit straight away.
• Faster polls, and leaving a community clears its polls at once.
• A community's join QR or "choose a wallet" link opens Join in Keyring.
• Faster start-up, and an unreachable community says so straight away.
